methodology_note: GWPH (GW Pharmaceuticals plc) trades on Nasdaq as an ADS, with each ADS representing 12 ordinary shares (FY2017 20-F, filed 2017-12-04, Citibank N.A. depositary). SEC XBRL dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding for this issuer is reported in ordinary shares, not ADS-equivalent units, and the earliest XBRL record available (2018-11-12) postdates this event; the pre-event share count below is instead sourced directly from the FY2017 20-F cover page (304,439,740 ordinary shares as of 2017-09-30, filed 2017-12-04, before the 2018-02-21 event), converted to ADS-equivalent units by dividing by the 12:1 ratio before computing market cap. Using the raw ordinary-share count directly against the ADS price (as scripts/m7_lib_marketdata.py's automated shares lookup would do for a 1:1 domestic filer) would overstate market cap by roughly 12x; this row's market_cap_proxy_usd is deliberately not machine-generated by run_universe_check for that reason.

rows.shares_outstanding_basis: 304,439,740 ordinary shares (FY2017 20-F cover page, as of 2017-09-30, filed 2017-12-04) divided by the 12-ordinary-shares-per-ADS ratio disclosed in the same 20-F
rows.corporate_action_note: Raw (unadjusted) SIP daily bars are used throughout; any split/dividend action before the cutoff is inherently reflected as-traded and requires no separate adjustment for the floor check.
rows.determination_sufficiency: All floor components pass with wide margin; market cap alone clears the floor by roughly 67x even after the 12:1 ADS conversion.
rows.market_data_retrieval_note: Alpaca SIP daily bars, adjustment=raw. Share count sourced manually from the FY2017 20-F cover page text (not XBRL) because this issuer's earliest XBRL-tagged share count postdates the event by nine months; scripts/m7_lib_marketdata.py's automated shares_outstanding lookup correctly returned no eligible pre-event row rather than silently using a post-event figure.
